abstract: We compared clinical characteristics and autoantibodies against GluRepsilon2 between 95 patients with nonparaneoplastic non-herpetic acute limbic encephalitis (NPNHALE) and 19 patients with non-herpetic acute encephalitis accompanying ovarian teratoma (NHAE-OT). Onset age (mean +/- SD) was 27.7 +/- 18.6 years old in NPNHALE, 27.5 +/- 6.5 in NHALE-OT. Preceding factors were found in 63.8% of patients with NPNHALE and 89.5% of patients with NHALE-OT (Fisher's exact test, p = 0.025), and major preceding factors were upper respiratory infections or fever in both groups. Symptoms at the onset were disorder of behavior and talk > seizures > impairment of consciousness in NPNHALE, and disorder of behavior and talk > seizures > disorientation in NHALE-OT. Symptoms at the acute stage were similar between NPNHALE and NHAE-OT, but duration of hospital stay was longer in NHAE-OT (209.0 days) than NPNHALE (87.5 days) (Mann Whitney test, p<0.0001). At the onset, cell counts in CSF were 51.6 +/- 66.4/mm3 and protein levels were 35.4 +/- 14.7 mg/dl, and IgG levels were 6.6 +/- 4.2 mg/dl in NHAE-OT, and these data were not significantly different between NPNHALE and NHAE-OT. In acute stage, autoantibodies against whole molecule of GluRepsilon2 in CSF were detected in 51.8% (29/56) of adult NPNHALE, and 40% (6/15) of NHAE-OT patients by immunoblot. These autoantibodies in both groups included epitopes to n-terminal of GluRepsilon2. Antibodies against NMDAR complex (Dalmau's method) in CSF were detected in 90.9% (10/11) of NHAE-OT patients.
abstract_ja: 我々は、非傍腫瘍性非ヘルペス性急性辺縁系脳炎(NPNHALE)95例と、卵巣奇形腫を伴う非ヘルペス性急性脳炎(NHAE-OT)19例について、臨床的特徴とGluRε2に対する自己抗体を比較した。発症年齢(平均±SD)は、NPNHALEで27.7±18.6歳、NHAE-OTで27.5±6.5歳であった。先行因子はNPNHALEの63.8%、NHAE-OTの89.5%で認められ(Fisher正確検定、p=0.025)、主な先行因子は両群とも上気道感染または発熱であった。発症時の症状は、NPNHALEでは行動・会話の障害 > けいれん > 意識障害の順、NHAE-OTでは行動・会話の障害 > けいれん > 失見当識の順であった。急性期の症状は両群で類似していたが、入院期間はNHAE-OT(209.0日)がNPNHALE(87.5日)より長かった(Mann-Whitney検定、p<0.0001)。発症時の髄液細胞数は51.6±66.4/mm³、蛋白は35.4±14.7 mg/dl、IgGは6.6±4.2 mg/dl(NHAE-OT)であり、これらの値はNPNHALEとNHAE-OTの間で有意差はなかった。急性期において、免疫ブロットで髄液中のGluRε2全分子に対する自己抗体は、成人NPNHALEの51.8%(29/56)、NHAE-OT患者の40%(6/15)で検出された。両群の自己抗体はいずれもGluRε2のN末端のエピトープを含んでいた。Dalmau法によるNMDAR複合体に対する髄液中抗体は、NHAE-OT患者の90.9%(10/11)で検出された。
